changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE book_editorial ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, catalog_id bigint UNIQUE REFERENCES books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, library_id varchar(36) UNIQUE REFERENCES java_library(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, description varchar(3000), lists varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', comment varchar(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK ((catalog_id IS NOT NULL AND library_id IS NULL) OR (catalog_id IS NULL AND library_id IS NOT NULL)) );
